rationale: No supported optimization applies cleanly. P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (cache dependency downloads) is contraindicated because the workflow already enables dependency caching via `voidzero-dev/setup-vp` with `cache: true`, matching the 'equivalent cache already exists' contraindication. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is contraindicated because this is a release/deployment workflow that submits to the Chrome Web Store and Firefox Addon Store. P-LIT-FAIL-FAST and P-LIT-FAILED-JOB-FIRST do not apply (no matrix). P-LIT-SELECT and P-LIT-PRIORITIZE do not apply (no test suite; this is a build/release workflow). P-LIT-BAZEL-* do not apply (no Bazel). P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE and P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE do not apply (no schedule trigger). P-LIT-CHANGE-FILTER is already present via the `packages/extension/package.json` path filter. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT is not supported: the CI history only shows short check-version-only runs (9-61 s), not representative durations for build/store-submission jobs, and valid store submissions can be slow, so imposing a limit risks interrupting valid runs. All other patterns are out of scope or lack preconditions. The change preserves intended build and test coverage and makes no unrelated modifications.
